file_id: For The vs State on 17 February, 2025

sentences.text: For The vs State on 17 February, 2025

Author: Suvra Ghosh
Bench: Suvra Ghosh
17.02.2025 jb.
jdt.
C.R.R. 485 of 2025 Re: Suresh Agarwal @ Suresh Kumar Agarwal Mr. Sekhar Kr. Basu Mr.
Shiladitya Banerjee Mr. Arnab Chatterjee ...

For the Petitioner The petitioner seeks quashing of proceeding being G.R. case no. 333 of 2020 pending before the learned 18th Judicial Magistrate,
Calcutta.
Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that charge- sheet has been submitted against the petitioner under Section 120B/269/273 of the Indian Penal Code.

Placing reliance on the authority in Ram Nath vs. State of Uttar Pradesh reported in AIR 2024 Supreme Court 1652, learned counsel submits that in view of the overriding effect of the Food Safety and Standards Act over anything inconsistent therewith contained in any other law for the time being in force, charge-sheet submitted under the provisions of Indian Penal Code is bad in law.

entities.text: Ram Nath vs. State of Uttar Pradesh reported in AIR 2024 Supreme Court 1652
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: The petitioner appears to have made out an arguable case.
The petitioner is directed to serve copy of the application along with annexure thereto upon the opposite parties and file affidavit of service on the adjourned date.
Let the matter appear under the heading 'Contested Application' in the monthly list of April, 2025.
Further proceedings of G.R. case no. 333 of 2020 pending before the learned 18th Judicial Magistrate, Calcutta be stayed till 30th April, 2025 or until further orders, whichever is earlier.

(Suvra Ghosh, J.)
